rules.reason: Plans, specs and audits go in the issue tracker, not new .md files in the repo. Write content docs under docs/blog/ or ask the user first.
This project uses npm. Use npm / npx instead of bun / bunx.
Do not open pull requests unless the user asks for one.
Production EAS build: needs the user's explicit go-ahead.
OTA update: confirm lint passed and the channel, runtime version and env are right before shipping.
